summary: The implementation addresses most requirements for custom Instagram story images. Backend storage for travel styles with base images is implemented (REQ-6 backend), frontend admin UI for uploads is complete (REQ-6 frontend), and Instagram story generation with custom backgrounds exists (REQ-7). However, the implementation shows no evidence of integrating the uploaded images into the quiz results display (REQ-8), and there's no evidence of actual image upload functionality being wired to the backend or working end-to-end.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend storage of uploaded images associated with travel styles
missing_requirements.reason: While backend/main.mo shows travelStyles data structure with baseImage field and file upload endpoints exist, there's no evidence in the diff that the QuizManager upload functionality actually calls these backend methods to persist the uploaded image associations. The useFileUpload hook is imported but the actual mutation to update travel style baseImage is not shown.

missing_requirements.requirement: Display the generated Instagram story image in the first tile of the quiz results page
missing_requirements.reason: TravelStyleQuiz.tsx shows generateTravelStyleQuizStory and downloadInstagramStory imports, but the diff is truncated and does not show the quiz results rendering section. There's no evidence that the first tile displays the generated image with custom uploaded background, or that the download functionality is properly integrated into the results page UI.

missing_requirements.requirement: Retrieve admin-uploaded base image for user's primary travel style after quiz completion
missing_requirements.reason: While useGetAllTravelStyles hook exists to fetch travel styles, there's no evidence in the truncated TravelStyleQuiz.tsx diff showing that the quiz completion flow retrieves the specific baseImage for the user's result and passes it to the Instagram story generator.

hallucinated_features.description: Migration module for backend data structure upgrade
hallucinated_features.reason: backend/migration.mo adds a migration system for upgrading the actor state to include travelStyles. This is an implementation detail not requested in the BuildRequest and goes beyond the constraint to 'store uploaded images using the existing file storage registry pattern'.
